Ilhan Omar thread kept running: '19 naturalized immigrants in Congress' (~379k, 42k likes), 'remove Ilhan Omar before the midterms' (~91k, 16k likes), FBI went through her trash (~78k), alx trash-agents joke (~24k)

Builders still beat government in the feed: 'two nights ago I saw a car fly' (~203k, 22.6k likes), Elon giving one SpaceX share to every American kid (~172k), alx Bluesky thinks the Roadster demo was fake (~86k)
Ask-@Grok slot cooled off: 'most challenging question' (~332k) and 'friendliest state' (~307k) led, well below last week's ~3M peaks, and the like rate stayed tiny (under 1k likes each)

Format notes: short declarative one-liners carried the best like rates ('Without X…' 16% likes per view, 'Don't France my AMERICA' 15%, 'He needs to be removed' 15%); long 'BOOM / UNREAL' explainers pulled the biggest raw views; on a big foreign story, the posts that framed it as a warning for America outperformed straight updates
virals_narrative: Outsider AI sweep (~48h, two searches, 50 posts) stayed quiet: only two posts cleared 5k views. Tops were a warning that hackers broke into an AI coding tool and ran up stolen OpenAI and Anthropic keys (~8.9k, users reporting $400 to $1,700 bills), a CoreWeave capex take (~6.9k), and a 'most insane week in AI' recap of GPT-6 reaching ChatGPT users (~4.3k). The rest was recap threads, Replit switching its default model to OpenAI, Meta's Muse Wonder, Anthropic putting 5% of its shares in a public benefit fund, and a lot of crypto-agent spam. Watchlist heat, led by the Clancy follow-up and the France riots, carried the board.
narrative_synthesis: Weekend watchlist heat (Fri Oct 16 to Mon Oct 19): rawsalerts' Lindsay Clancy follow-up (~1.24M) topped the window; France's riots drove Gunther's weekend with five posts over 600k (looting wife ~735k, Lyon shop owner ~708k, Le Pen ~622k, 'Without X' ~614k with 100k likes); Katie Zacharia's four-day exit (~589k), Ilhan Omar follow-ups, and election-integrity receipts filled the rest.
